defs.title: Missing survey vessel
defs.text: A survey vessel missed its last check-in. Its beacon leads to a derelict field off your route. Investigate, or continue your charter.

defs.title: Convoy charter
defs.text: Your convoy has a civilian charter to Port Meridian. Deliver cargo, refuel and keep the company solvent. Other frontier stops are yours to explore.

text_variants.text: Your security company is escorting a civilian convoy to Port Meridian. Deliver the charter, refuel and keep your ships ready.
Your survey company is carrying a commercial charter to Port Meridian. Deliver the cargo and keep the labs working while underway.
Your transport company has a charter to Port Meridian. Cargo and passengers pay on delivery at another trading port; their safety is your responsibility.

defs.title: Clear the docking ring
defs.text: Meridian Control: "Small organisms are blocking the evacuation approach. Clear them and we can get our people out."

defs.title: Fuel on the margin
defs.text: "Corporate inspections are holding up the tankers," the independent hauler reports. "Forty fuel for sixty credits, if you need it."

defs.title: Drone vanguard
defs.text: More of the alien craft, flying in formation this time. They have been waiting along the lane.

defs.title: Leviathan Protocol
defs.text: COLONIAL EMERGENCY BROADCAST: A Leviathan-class organism and coordinated biological attacks are confirmed. All registered flagships are requisitioned under Leviathan Protocol. Clear Bastion Gate and proceed to fleet assembly. Requisition funds and incident telemetry are attached.

text_variants.text: COLONIAL EMERGENCY BROADCAST: Coordinated biological attacks and a Leviathan-class organism are confirmed. Leviathan Protocol is in effect. Your survey company is requisitioned for fleet service. Clear Bastion Gate and proceed to assembly. Funds and incident telemetry are attached.

COLONIAL EMERGENCY BROADCAST: Coordinated biological attacks and a Leviathan-class organism are confirmed. Leviathan Protocol is in effect. Your transport company is requisitioned for fleet service. Clear Bastion Gate and proceed to assembly. Funds and incident telemetry are attached.

COLONIAL EMERGENCY BROADCAST: Coordinated biological attacks and a Leviathan-class organism are confirmed. Leviathan Protocol is in effect. Your security company is requisitioned for fleet service. Clear Bastion Gate and proceed to assembly. Funds and incident telemetry are attached.

defs.title: Swarm scouts
defs.text: A larger pack peels away from the swarm and turns toward the convoy.

defs.title: Asteroid corridor
defs.text: The lane narrows into a drifting rock field. Something is hiding among the rocks.

defs.title: Derelict field
defs.text: A damaged survey ship drifts beside empty freighters. Its last log mentions a restricted corporate route; the rest is unreadable.

defs.title: Distress call
defs.text: A merchant hauler is pinned down by alien craft. Its captain offers to join your fleet if you clear the attackers.

defs.title: Pale nebula
defs.text: The cloud is laced with organic filaments. Your labs could learn a great deal, if the hulls can take the radiation.

text_variants.text: Your labs detect repeating signals within the organic filaments. Their purpose is unknown. A closer study exposes every surviving hull to radiation.

defs.title: The Warden
defs.text: An armored Warden blocks the assembly route, protected by two pylons. Clear the gate so the convoy can answer the mobilization order.

defs.title: Port Meridian
defs.text: Meridian Control: "Welcome, independent convoy. Cargo brokers are open, fuel is available, and the yard can refit your ships. Check your supplies before departure."

defs.title: Contact at the docking ring
defs.text: Meridian Control: "No transponder. Something has attached to the ring. We are losing pressure; there are people trapped inside. Departing vessels, please help."

defs.title: The evacuation channel
defs.text: Meridian Control: "The approach is clear. Evacuation crews are moving. We have lost sections of the ring, but the port is holding. Thank you, convoy."

defs.title: Meridian falls silent
defs.text: The distress channel stops. An evacuation broadcast lists missing crews and orders all traffic away from Port Meridian. The abandoned port offers no services.

defs.title: The last shuttle
defs.text: You clear the approach as the remaining shuttles scatter. Meridian Control does not answer. The evacuation failed; the abandoned port offers no services.

defs.title: Sealed corporate convoy
defs.text: A corporate convoy requests ten fuel for twenty-five credits. Its cargo manifest is sealed, but the destination matches a restricted research corridor.

defs.title: Patrol inspection
defs.text: "Routine charter check," the patrol officer says. "Corporate security keeps asking for restricted-route traffic records. Your public manifest will suffice; private clearance costs twenty credits."

defs.title: Settlement shortage
defs.text: The colony clinic has supplies waiting at the dock but cannot pay the handling charge. Thirty credits would release them. Your ordinary cargo is settled separately.

defs.title: Requisition queue
defs.text: The duty officer processes your civilian charter. "We need every flagship at assembly. Relief crews also need funds, but I will not order you to empty your repair account."

text_variants.text: "The settlement clinic sent its thanks," the duty officer says. "Relief crews still need funds. Keep enough to get your convoy through the gate."
"Meridian reported your help," the duty officer says. "More survivors are arriving. Relief funds are voluntary; the order to proceed to assembly is not."
"Meridian is gone," the duty officer says. "We are supporting the survivors who escaped. Donate if you can, then get your convoy to assembly."
